name: GMGN
rootCause: GMGN stated in the community, "The GMGN website has suffered a malicious attack, suspected to involve multiple methods, including common crawler attacks and flood attacks. The development team is currently working on emergency repairs, and the token details page, holdings collection feature, and transaction activity records have been restored."
